settings.title: Kami Faham, Penat Jaga Semua Orang

settings.editor: Anda yang selalu fikirkan orang lain dulu — kulit sendiri kusam pun tak sempat peduli, mak ayah mengadu lenguh, suami balik kerja nampak letih. Nak cari herba yang selamat, tapi takut tersalah pilih.
🌿
Kulit rasa tak segar, kering dan kusam lepas seharian. Nak sabun herba yang lembut untuk guna hari-hari.
🤲
Selalu sebut sengal dan lenguh lepas buat kerja rumah atau kebun. Nak minyak urutan yang cepat meresap, tak melekit.
💪
Badan rasa kurang cergas, susah nak kekal aktif. Nak ikhtiar herba yang mudah — bancuh, minum atau bawa ke mana-mana.
Sebab tu Herbalabz wujud — herba tradisi, disediakan cara moden supaya senang anda guna setiap hari.

settings.title: Tak Pasti Nak Mula Mana? Ikut Ni:

settings.editor: Mula dengan → Kemuning Glow Soap + Teh Herba Osmanthus
Sebab: lembut, harian, paling mudah serasi.
Pilih ikut keselesaan → Minyak Raja Perkasa (luaran) / Uncang Herba (dalaman) / Maajun Tok Urat (cergas)
Sebab: ikut rutin dia — suka urut atau suka bancuh minum?
Ambil → Minyak Sendicare Plus + Teh Herba Osmanthus
Sebab: urutan harian yang tak melekit + minuman tenang petang-petang.
Masih tak pasti? Cerita sikit siapa nak guna — kami tolong pilihkan.

<script>(function(){
  document.documentElement.classList.add('js');
  var rm=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var hdr=document.querySelector('header[role="banner"]');
  window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){hdr.classList.toggle('is-scrolled',window.scrollY>8)},{passive:true});
  if(hdr){hdr.classList.toggle('is-scrolled',window.scrollY>8);}
  function activateTab(btn){
    var all=document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
    all.forEach(function(b){var a=b===btn;b.setAttribute('aria-selected',a?'true':'false');b.setAttribute('tabindex',a?'0':'-1');b.classList.toggle('bg-herba',a);b.classList.toggle('text-white',a);b.classList.toggle('bg-cream',!a);b.classList.toggle('border',!a);b.classList.toggle('border-sand',!a);});
    var panels=document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');
    panels.forEach(function(p){var s=p.id===btn.getAttribute('data-tab');p.hidden=!s;if(s&&!rm){p.classList.remove('panel-in');void p.offsetWidth;p.classList.add('panel-in');}});
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){activateTab(btn);});
    btn.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){var idx=null;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')idx=(tabBtns.indexOf(btn)+1)%tabBtns.length;if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')idx=(tabBtns.indexOf(btn)-1+tabBtns.length)%tabBtns.length;if(idx!==null){e.preventDefault();tabBtns[idx].focus();activateTab(tabBtns[idx]);}});
  });
  var tabBtns=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn'));
  document.querySelectorAll('main section h2').forEach(function(h){if(!h.classList.contains('reveal'))h.classList.add('reveal');});
  var revealEls=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal,.reveal-group'));
  if(!rm&&'IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){entries.forEach(function(en){if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('is-visible');io.unobserve(en.target);}})},{threshold:0.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});
  } else { revealEls.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('is-visible');}); }
  var faqBtns=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.faq-btn'));
  function fh(panel,open){var c=btn=>{var x=btn.querySelector('.faq-chevron');if(x)x.style.transform=open?'rotate(180deg)':'';};var done=function(e){if(e&&e.propertyName&&e.propertyName!=='height')return;panel.classList.remove('animating');panel.style.height='';panel.style.opacity='';panel.style.paddingBottom='';panel.removeEventListener('transitionend',done);};
    if(open){panel.hidden=false;panel.classList.add('animating');var fh2=panel.scrollHeight;panel.style.height='0px';panel.style.opacity='0';requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){panel.style.height=fh2+'px';panel.style.opacity='1';});});setTimeout(function(){if(panel.classList.contains('animating'))done();},300);}
    else{panel.style.height=panel.offsetHeight+'px';panel.classList.add('animating');requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){panel.style.height='0px';panel.style.opacity='0';});});setTimeout(function(){if(panel.classList.contains('animating'))done();},300);}
  }
  faqBtns.forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){var willOpen=document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden;fh(document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('aria-controls')),willOpen);});});
})();</script>
